```cypher
MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(a:Asset)<-[:SAME_AS]-(d:Drive)
WHERE d.failure_date IS NOT NULL AND c.opened_at IS NOT NULL
WITH c, date(substring(c.opened_at, 0, 10)) AS opened, date(substring(d.failure_date, 0, 10)) AS failed_on
WHERE opened >= failed_on AND opened <= failed_on + duration({days: 7})
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cases
```
